reveal_lines: The Crawling Chaos remembers.
Turn 1, as you arrived on a level: whisper 1 (ambient) was admitted.
Telegraph: "A distant whisper brushes against your thoughts."
Effect: an omen only; no rule changed.
Delivered: yes, "The shadows lean closer." was shown with the telegraph.
Spent at once.
Turn 17, after you doubled back: a haunting was admitted.
Telegraph: "Something has learned the rhythm of your footsteps."
Effect: an echo hound was set to follow your trail.
Delivered: yes, you saw it follow your trail 1 time.
Ended: its hunt ended on turn 77.
Motif: the whistle, 1 program, felt 0 times.
Turn 925: next-use program 2 was admitted.
Origin: you whistled on DL2 on turn 850.
Rebound: first written about an earlier one (turn 393).
Telegraph: "For a while, your whistles may carry farther than they should."
Effect: for a while, any whistle could answer it, at most 2 times.
Delivered: no; no manifestation reached you.
Ended: its uses ran out or it expired before the game ended.
Turn 1032, as you arrived on a level: whisper 2 (door_reluctance) was admitted.
Telegraph: "The doors of this place seem to lean against you."
Effect: closed doors resisted you more often, for 62 turns.
Delivered: no; a rule change has no separate manifestation.
Ended: expired on turn 1094.
Admitted 4, delivered 2; cruelty spent 4.
2 other candidates were refused; none took effect.
